fml.menu.mods.info.description.tardis_ro: A hand-built TARDIS interior: grow rooms and corridors with the sonic screwdriver on a grid, instead of Tardis Refined's endless procedural ARS corridors. The TARDIS Interface carries items, fluids, energy and redstone between rooms and to the outside, plus Mekanism chemicals and AE2 ME networks.

screen.tardis_rooms.interface.face.toolt: Shows the interface with its neighbours: click a side to switch it. Insert puts into the neighbour what linked inputs have (needs output); Extract takes from the neighbour and sends to linked outputs (needs input). A wrench switches the clicked side too.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.flow.toolt: Click to switch. Input: takes in — whatever is fed here goes to linked output interfaces. Output: gives — takes from the neighbours of linked input interfaces.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.help:
• To link interfaces, give them the same ID.
• The interface stores nothing and passes everything on at once: the speed depends on the pipes and machines.
• Sides set to Insert or Extract work with plain chests, no pipes needed. Set them up with the cube button.
• Wrench: right click switches a side, Shift + right click picks the interface up.
• Works only while its chunk is loaded.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.id.clear.t: Removes the current ID from the interface: it stops being linked. Putting it into a crafting grid does the same.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.id.generat: Gives this interface a new unique ID. Interfaces with the same ID are linked, like P2P tunnels.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.id.paste.e: The screwdriver in your hand has no ID — copy one with Shift + right click on another interface (Setup mode)

screen.tardis_rooms.interface.id.paste.t: Same as Shift + left click on the interface with the screwdriver in Setup mode
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.me.tooltip: Joins the ME networks next to linked interfaces into one (a dense connection, like a quantum bridge). Works both ways regardless of direction.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.redstone.t: Click to toggle. The signal next to input interfaces is given off by linked output interfaces (the strongest one). With "input and output" the interface only reads the signal — otherwise it would catch its own signal and latch forever.
screen.tardis_rooms.interface.sides.hint: Left click — next mode, right click — previous, Shift + click — default. Drag to rotate.
